direction: Small traces, shared life: bright festival colour, a patient creature close to the ground, and a shore after withdrawal. Vary scale, saturation and mark-making; a new interpretive direction, not a historical editorial theme.

items.title: After the shared colour
items.rationale: The Holi poem joins estranged people through shared celebration. Evoke the ordinary aftermath of meeting, not a staged festival advertisement or a crowd of invented faces.

review.notes: Normal-size review: pink and yellow mingle through actual paving joints, with a partly cropped basin giving the wet colour a credible origin. Natural reflected light and quiet open stone balance the vivid patch. Clearly painted rather than documentary, no generic festival crowd, symmetrical props or advertising spectacle. The contact metaphor supports the poem without claiming a real celebration.

items.alt: Pink and yellow Holi colour mingle in shallow rinse water across pale stone paving beside a cropped steel basin.

items.title: A small pace through green
items.rationale: Hold On places patient small lives beside mortality. Choose the first easy-going slug among tiny flowers as one quiet encounter; leave the other haiku images to the language.

review.notes: Normal-size review: a single slug rests continuously against moss, with a plausible mantle, tapering body and feelers. White flowers and moss dissolve into open paper; no fairy effects or shell. Slug is larger than the one-fifth-width preference but remains subordinate to substantial breathing space, so no cosmetic retry. Patient movement serves the first haiku while leaving death and other images in the text.

items.alt: A small brown slug moves through moss and two white woodland flowers in a spare watercolor study.

items.title: After the retreat
items.rationale: Game of Sea shifts from apparently friendly waves to what they carry away and expose. Make absence perceptible through the shore, without a literal bone or treasure tableau.

review.notes: Normal-size review: quiet receding wavelets, wet margins and shallow vacant impressions make removal legible. Embedded stones and cropped root belong to the shore and cast modest coherent shadows. Uneven placement and open sand avoid a decorative collection. The subdued watercolor has movement without spectacle; no added human story or documentary claim.

items.alt: Gentle seawater retreats across sand with scattered pebbles, shallow empty impressions and a cropped root.

text_led.rationale: The short life-reckoning moves between mathematics and grief; let its lineation carry those transitions without an equation collage.
The ironic turn from danger in darkness to wounds in daylight gains force without depicting ghosts, snakes or a literal menacing street.
Keep the demand for privacy and agency in the words; avoid a voyeuristic woman image or a literal four-panel metaphor.
